newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy says well under control.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy says well under control.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said Tuesday that its No. 3 Well at South Timbalier Block 8 Field, which experienced a natural gas blowout, is now under control.
The well blowout, which was announced last week, was killed after a tubing bridge plug was set and cement was applied to completely isolate the well.

The company said spill control strategies centered on the protection of the Isle Dernieres chain of barrier islands, some of which contain bird nesting areas. It said that no environmental impact to those areas has been detected.
Stone Energy is an independent oil and gas company.
